answer: The walnut cap is checked at intake and lantern publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, since every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a island tag. That is 24 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
